create.namePlaceholder: Example album name in the name field.

list.photoCount: Small uppercase pill on an album card.

form.namePlaceholder: Example name for an API key, shown greyed out in the empty field.
form.read: Checkbox column: allow reading this resource.
form.write: Checkbox column: allow changing this resource.

apiKeys.intro: <guide> and <openapi> wrap links. new-lifer: a lifer is a species photographed for the first time ever.
apiKeys.revoke: Button: permanently disable an API key.

revokeConfirm.title: {name} is the API key's name, chosen by the user.

scopes.gallery: Row label in the API key permission grid: the resource a key can access.
scopes.lifeList: Row label in the API key permission grid. Life list: the user's list of species photographed (a birding term).

collections.title: Page title. Albums are hand-picked photo collections; trips are photos imported from one trip's folder on disk.

api.desktop_only: API error code desktop_only: the server refused an action that only the desktop app (with its local library) can do.
api.invalid_request: API error code invalid_request: the server rejected malformed input. The English server message names the field; this is the generic version.
api.no_checklist: API error code no_checklist: a species can't be added to a region (like a continent) that has no species checklist of its own.
api.no_video_frames: API error code no_video_frames: species matching couldn't decode any frames from an uploaded video.
api.not_added: API error code not_added: removing a species the user hadn't added to a region's or sea zone's checklist.
api.pack_index_unavailable: API error code pack_index_unavailable: the list of downloadable offline packs couldn't be fetched (usually offline).
api.reorganize_failed: API error code reorganize_failed: moving original photo files into the year or location folder layout failed.
api.storage_move_failed: API error code storage_move_failed: moving the photo library to another folder or drive failed.
api.suggestion_failed: API error code suggestion_failed: the species suggestion model couldn't analyse a photo or video (often because it isn't downloaded yet).

albumPicker.title: Heading when the Gallery is opened to pick photos for an album. {album} is the album's name.
albumPicker.titleUnnamed: Same heading while the album's name is still loading.

count.matchingRead: {query} is the user's search text; {reading} is how it was understood, e.g. "ducks · Washington · 2024".
count.missingDate: The Gallery's missing-date view, a to-do list of photos with no capture date.
count.missingDateAtLeast: Same, while more photos are still loading.

hidden.unhidToast: Toast after unhiding photos that were imported hidden because a culling app rejected them.

gallery.loadingMore: Screen reader label of the spinner at the bottom of the grid.

searchReading.looksLike: How a photo search was understood: the part matched by what the picture looks like. {description} is from the user's search text.
searchReading.more: How a photo search was understood: after the first three species names, how many more matched.

gallery.title: Page title of the Gallery: every photo in the library in one grid.
gallery.unknownRegion: Group heading for photos with no region when the grid is grouped by region.

raw.linkedCount: {linked} of {total} RAW files were matched to photos already in the library.

badge.assessedTitle: Hover text on the IUCN badge.
badge.label: Badge on a species page. {category} is an IUCN Red List category name, like Least Concern.

category.extinct: IUCN Red List category name. Use the official IUCN Red List term in your language if one exists.
category.lowerRiskConservationDependent: Old (1994) IUCN Red List category, still on a few assessments. Use the official IUCN term if one exists.

stat.notEvaluated: Value in the species stats box when IUCN has not assessed the species.

language.automatic: First option of the language picker: use the browser's or operating system's language when Lifer has it, else English.
language.description: Under the Language heading in Settings > General. Species common names are data from the catalog, not part of the interface.

groups.general: A tab in the Settings sidebar (also listed in the command palette). Keep tab names short.
groups.offlineData: Settings tab for the downloaded species catalog, offline packs and maps.

settings.help: Link at the bottom of the Settings sidebar to the online Settings documentation.
settings.retry: Button to try loading again after an error.

photos.placeInRegion: Where a photo was taken. {place} is the place name the user typed (like Prince George), {region} the province, state or country it is in.
photos.yourPhotos: Heading of the user's own photos section on a species page.

picker.listLabel: Accessible name of the species search results list.
picker.searchInaturalistNoMatch: Last row of the species search results. {query} is what the user typed. The arrow means it opens a search on the iNaturalist website.

shotData.aperture: Photographic aperture (f-number), e.g. f/5.6. Usually left as is.
shotData.focalLength: Lens focal length in a compact camera-settings line under a photo, e.g. 400mm.

suggestion.match: Under a suggested species card. {percent} is a formatted percentage like 87%: how closely the photo matches the species.

create.buildHint: {name} is the trip's name as typed by the user (user data). "Wildlife" is the folder name on disk and stays as is.
create.buildSubmit: Button that creates a new trip folder on disk and starts importing into it.
create.namePlaceholder: Example trip name in the name field.
create.untitled: Default trip name when none is typed; also used as a folder name.

detail.addMorePhotos: Button that rescans the trip's folder for photos not imported yet.
detail.backLabel: Label of the back link at the top of a trip's page, leading to the trips list.

build.scanInstead: "Add more photos" is the label of the button above; keep it matching that translation.

detail.deleteRawToo: RAW is the camera raw file stored alongside the photo.

filters.labels: Checkbox in the filter menu: show species name labels on photo thumbnails.
filters.topRated: Checkbox in the filter menu: show only the highest-rated photos.

detail.noPhotosMatch: {search} is the text typed in the search box.
detail.noSpeciesMatch: {search} is the text typed in the search box.
detail.trashMessage: Trash is the app's bin for deleted photos (its own page).

info.addMore: "Add more photos" is the label of a button on the trip page; keep it matching that translation.
info.copiedOnImport: "Save wildlife to" is the label of a field on this page; "Wildlife" is the actual default folder name on disk and should stay as is. RAW is a camera raw file.
info.relocate: "Relocate…" is the label of a menu item on the trip page; keep it matching that translation.

list.buildTrip: Button: start a new trip by creating a fresh folder and importing photos into it (as opposed to importing an existing trip folder).
list.importTrip: Button: point Lifer at an existing trip folder on disk.

banner.keepDrive: Shown while uploads are being saved to an external drive.
banner.uploading: Status pill shown on every page while uploads run in the background. {done} of {total} files finished; the bracketed parts appear only when some files failed or were skipped as duplicates.

duplicate.message: {fileName} is the uploaded file's name, {species} a species name.
duplicate.messageWithDate: {fileName} is the uploaded file's name, {species} a species name, {date} the date the existing photo was taken.
duplicate.position: After the dialog title when several possible duplicates wait: this is the first of {total}.
duplicate.skip: Button: don't import this file because it is probably a duplicate.

raw.addedToFolder: Lower-case status after a RAW file's name. {name} is a species name; each species has a folder for RAW files.
raw.collision: Lower-case status after a RAW file's name. The camera fingerprint is the camera serial plus capture timestamp from EXIF.
raw.descriptionSpecies: On a species page. RAW: a camera's unprocessed image file (CR3, NEF, ARW...). JPEG: the processed photo.
raw.duplicate: Lower-case status after a RAW file's name.
raw.filedUnder: Lower-case status after a RAW file's name. {name} is a species name.
